answer: By the onyx of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nadir.
